# SwiftFreight Ground Services

SwiftFreight is a regional parcel carrier focused on small and medium businesses. We combine national reach through partner networks with the personal service of a local company, and every business customer has a named account manager who knows their shipping needs.

## Flat-rate ground

Our flat-rate ground service keeps budgeting simple. One price covers any parcel up to ten kilograms going anywhere in the country, with tracking and proof of delivery included as standard.

FACT: SwiftFreight charges 7 dollars per parcel for flat-rate ground up to 10 kg.
FACT: SwiftFreight offers free daily pickup for accounts shipping 100 parcels per month.
FACT: SwiftFreight ground delivery takes 4 business days on average.

## Coverage

SwiftFreight delivers directly within our core region in two business days or less. Shipments to other regions travel through our partner network, which adds a day or two depending on the destination. Remote areas may incur a small surcharge.

## Tools for shippers

Our web portal lets you create labels, schedule pickups and download monthly reports. A simple integration is available for common ecommerce platforms, and our support team can help connect custom order systems.

## Service promise

If a ground parcel is lost, SwiftFreight refunds the shipping charge and covers the declared value up to a set limit. Our account managers review delivery performance with each customer every quarter and work with them to resolve recurring issues.

## Contract terms

Business contracts run month to month with thirty days notice for cancellation. There are no setup fees, and new accounts receive their first two weeks of shipping at a discounted introductory rate.
